annotations.title: List the pages of a site

description: Lists every page of a site (home first) with its path, name, draft preview URL and live URL. Use the path as the page parameter of edit_section, add_section, list_sections and the version tools. Free.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

site_key.description: The site whose pages to list. Defaults to the caller's current draft site when omitted.

name: list_pages
title: List the pages of a site
